case_number: WRIT PETITION (C) NO. 421 OF 2019; WRIT PETITION (C) NO. 777 OF 2020; WRIT PETITION (C) NO. 712 OF 2020

parties.petitioner: Moser Baer Karamchari Union Thr. President Mahesh Chand Sharma; Manoj Kumar Nagar; Raj Kumar Verma

summary: Constitutional challenge to Section 327(7) of Companies Act, 2013 and Section 53(1)(b)(i) of IBC regarding workmen's dues prioritization; distinction between liquidation under IBC vs Companies Act, 2013; examination of legislative history from Companies Act, 1956 to 2013 and Bankruptcy Law Reforms Committee recommendations; analysis of 'overriding preferential payments' provisions for workmen; pari passu treatment of workmen dues and secured creditors in Companies Act regime; 24-month dues limitation under IBC challenged as violating Articles 14 and 21; interpretation of waterfall mechanism under IBC Section 53; consideration of Eradi Committee and Irani Committee recommendations.
final_judgment: Judgment text truncated; specific final judgment disposition not clearly stated in provided excerpt but relates to constitutional validity challenge of provisions regarding workmen's dues prioritization in liquidation proceedings.
